# telnyx_sim_card_group (Resource)

A group of SIM cards that share a data limit, a private wireless gateway and a wireless blocklist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_sim_card_group" "fleet" {
  name = "fleet"
  data_limit = {
    amount = "2048"
    unit   = "MB"
  }
  private_wireless_gateway_id = telnyx_private_wireless_gateway.office.id
  wireless_blocklist_id       = telnyx_wireless_blocklist.no_roaming.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A user friendly name for the SIM card group.

### Optional

- `data_limit` (Attributes) Upper limit on the amount of data the SIM cards, within the group, can use. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_limit))
- `private_wireless_gateway_id` (String) The identification of the related Private Wireless Gateway resource.
- `wireless_blocklist_id` (String) The identification of the related Wireless Blocklist resource.

### Read-Only

- `consumed_data` (Attributes) Represents the amount of data consumed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consumed_data))
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `default` (Boolean) Indicates whether the SIM card group is the users default group.<br/>The default group is created for the user and can not be removed.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.
